title: Identifiability from Stationary Covariance in Linear SDEs with Reciprocal Interactions and Latent Variables
abstract: arXiv:2610.31310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time stochastic differential equations (SDEs) provide a natural framework for modeling interacting dynamical systems. A central causal question is whether causal effects among observed variables can be identified from observational data drawn from the stationary distribution, given the underlying causal graph. For linear SDEs, existing identifiability results are largely restricted to fully observed systems whose causal graphs contain no directed 2-cycles. We first establish new graphical conditions for the generic identifiability of causal effects in systems that may contain directed 2-cycles, thereby allowing for reciprocal interactions. Next, we address the previously unexplored setting of latent variables by developing an instrumental-variable framework for identifying a target direct causal effect under partial observability.

translated_title: 具有互惠作用与隐变量的线性随机微分方程中基于平稳协方差的可识别性研究
translated_abstract: 连续时间随机微分方程（SDE）为建模相互作用的动力系统提供了一个自然的框架。一个核心的因果问题是：在已知底层因果图的条件下，能否从来自平稳分布的观测数据中识别出观测变量之间的因果效应。对于线性随机微分方程而言，现有的可识别性结果大多局限于完全观测的系统，且要求其因果图中不包含有向2-环。我们首先为可能包含有向2-环的系统建立了因果效应一般可识别性的新图判定条件，从而允许系统中存在互惠（双向）相互作用。接着，我们研究了此前未被探索的隐变量情形，开发了一个工具变量框架，用于在部分可观测条件下识别目标直接因果效应。
tldr: 该论文为允许互惠相互作用（即因果图中含 有向2-环）的线性随机微分方程首次建立了基于平稳协方差的因果效应可识别性图判定条件，并进一步提出工具变量框架，解决了存在隐变量时部分可观测条件下目标直接因果效应的识别问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes new graphical conditions for the generic identifiability of causal effects from stationary covariance in linear SDEs allowing reciprocal interactions (directed 2-cycles), and develops an instrumental-variable framework to identify a target direct causal effect under partial observability with latent variables.
